title: Protocol V2.1 Stage 2A operator pilot

repeated_patterns_noticed: Several variants sharpen prose through concrete object placement or sound.
batch_assessment.notes: The four snippets are too small a sample for a strong batch-level conclusion.

batch_effect.notes: The accepted revisions use different concrete actions, but four snippets do not establish a reliable cross-scene trend.

stage_2a_overall_notes: The visible blinded prose was necessary to distinguish supported findings from plausible-sounding but contradicted claims.
overall_notes: Role reveal did not reverse either blind preference or either Stage 2A finding judgment.

blind_reasons: Turns summarized urgency into an audible trigger and visible physical action.
comparisons.blind_notes: The movement earns the urgency without changing the beat outcome.
comparisons.evidence_basis: C01: one displayed variant says only that she hurried, while the other supplies the lock sound and a three-at-a-time physical response.
comparisons.counterevidence_checked: C01: checked whether the context alone supplied a bodily consequence; it supplies the trigger but no visible response.
comparisons.finding_rationale: C01: the contrast directly demonstrates summarized urgency versus enacted urgency.
comparisons.variant_rationale: The challenger enacts urgency physically and matches both the blind preference and accepted finding.

blind_reasons: Lets the folded photograph carry the protective motive as subtext.
comparisons.blind_notes: Variant A explains the emotion already implied by the action.
comparisons.evidence_basis: C02: folding the protected person's photograph before refusing to answer already makes the protective motive legible through action.
comparisons.counterevidence_checked: C02: checked whether the action could read as unrelated business; the explicit protection context narrows its meaning sufficiently.
comparisons.finding_rationale: C02: naming the emotion removes useful subtext instead of repairing missing specificity.
comparisons.variant_rationale: The baseline was preferred blind and preserves the useful subtext identified during Stage 2A.

blind_reasons: The red lamp placement makes abandoning the package concrete and irreversible.
comparisons.blind_notes: The specific staging adds closure without explaining her feeling.
comparisons.evidence_basis: C03: leaving and going downstairs is generic, whereas placing the package under the red lamp fixes the abandoned object in a final location.
comparisons.counterevidence_checked: C03: checked whether going downstairs alone created equivalent finality; it ends movement but leaves the package staging abstract.
comparisons.finding_rationale: C03: the specific placement gives the exit a concrete irreversible action.
comparisons.variant_rationale: The challenger gives the package a concrete final placement and matches the accepted closure finding.

blind_reasons: The shorter sentence preserves the closed-door fact without redundant sound emphasis.
comparisons.blind_notes: Both variants work; Variant B is more economical.
comparisons.evidence_basis: C04: both displayed variants state that the deadbolt settled and that the courier was outside, already establishing closure.
comparisons.counterevidence_checked: C04: checked whether only the added metallic click established closure; the shared deadbolt and outside facts do so without it.
comparisons.finding_rationale: C04: the diagnostic claim conflicts with explicit facts present in both variants.
comparisons.variant_rationale: The baseline was preferred blind; Stage 2A also found that the added sound did not repair a real closure problem.
